abstract: The serum expression of the tumour markers hydroxybutyric dehydrogenase (HBD), beta human chorionic gonadotrophin (beta HCG), alphafetoprotein (alpha FP) and placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) has been assessed in a consecutive series of 50 patients with pure seminoma. In pre-orchiectomy sera from 15 patients with stage I disease, HBD was elevated in 5, beta HCG in 3, alpha FP in 1 and PLAP in 1 (of 3 only). In 27 patients with stage 2 or 3 disease, prior to chemotherapy, serum HBD was elevated in 19, beta HCG in 11, alpha FP in 2 and PLAP in 10 (of 18). The presence of beta HCG was investigated immunocytochemically in primary tumour tissue from 39 patients. It was demonstrated in 6 of 21 tumours from patients with stage I disease and 5 of 18 with stage 2 or 3 disease.
abstract_ja: 一連の純粋型セミノーマ患者50例において、血清中の腫瘍マーカーであるヒドロキシ酪酸脱水素酵素(HBD)、β-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(β-hCG)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)の発現を評価した。精巣摘除術前の血清では、病期Iの15例中、HBDが5例、β-hCGが3例、AFPが1例、PLAPが1例（3例中）で上昇していた。病期IIまたは病期IIIの27例では、化学療法前の血清HBDが19例、β-hCGが11例、AFPが2例、PLAPが10例（18例中）で上昇していた。39例の原発腫瘍組織についてβ-hCGを免疫細胞化学的に検討したところ、病期Iの21例中6例、病期IIまたは病期IIIの18例中5例で陽性であった。
